project_types.name: Advanced / Pre-Development

project_types.name: SOP Project with CSM (Turn Key Project)
project_types.description: Product Development up to SOP or partial SOP development, incl. release recommendation for AVL Development scope, including full component responsibility with Component Supplier Management (CSM)

project_types.name: Others
project_types.description: e.g. DRIVE/VSM/EPOS, Tippelmann test beds, certification and homologation, manufacturing, benchmarking…

lead_product_rule: For every Master Opportunity one of the “Products” shall be selected as “Lead Product”: The “Lead Product” is the dominant enabler for the project (customer view). The Lead Product does not necessarily have to be the product with the highest percentage, but must (of course) be among the chosen products (≥ 5%).

technologies.name: ICE & Mild Hybrid
technologies.description: Conventional powertrain incl. Micro Hybrid (Start/Stop and smart charging) and Mild Hybrid (capable of regenerative brake and torque assist/boost).

technologies.name: CO2-neutral ICE
technologies.description: Internal combustion engine designed primarily for operation with renewable fuels (e.g. H2, NH3, e-Fuel, methanol etc).

technologies.name: Hybrid
technologies.description: Capable of pure electric driving (Full Hybrid, PHEV).

technologies.name: Battery Electric
technologies.description: Battery Electric Vehicle or any other application of batteries, incl. stationary energy storage systems.

technologies.name: FC & EC
technologies.description: Fuel Cell and Electrolyzer Cell applications, either in vehicle or for stationary application, Power-to-Liquid applications.

technologies.name: ADAS
technologies.description: Scope of services/deliveries is mainly ADAS (powertrain type is irrelevant)

technologies.name: Other Green Tech.
technologies.description: Technology that contributes to reduction of CO2 and other GHG emissions, brake particle emissions, to reduced environmental impact of the product/service (resource requirements, recyclability etc.). Excluded: Development of conventional powertrain system, exhaust aftertreatment systems etc à must be allocated to Technology “ICE & Mild Hybrid”

technologies.name: Non-green Tech.
technologies.description: Non-CO2-neutral or with no explicit impact on reduction of GHG emission and/or improving environmental sustainability

products.name: Chassis & Vehicle Motion
products.description: Chassis and Vehicle Motion refers to all engineering activities for the sub-systems and components that contribute to the vehicle's dynamics, safety, comfort and driving experience: 1.Tires & Wheels, 2. Suspension System (spring-damper systems, control arms, bushings, and kinematics), 3. Steering System (EPS, SbW, RWS), 4.Braking System (Hydraulic and electronic brake systems (ABS, ESC, brake-by-wire) and 5. Vehicle Motion Control (central vehicle motion control/coordination, AWD, torque vectoring, ESC, TC, RWS, active suspension).

products.name: Vehicle Development and Integration
products.description: Complete vehicle development, powertrain and system in vehicle integration, demonstrator vehicles, platform development support, geometrical configuration, body, safety (active and passive), homologation, NVH, aerodynamics, vehicle benchmarking etc.

products.name: Thermal Management and HVAC
products.description: Thermal Management and HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning) of/for vehicles. → THM comprises e.g.: system design, component specification and supplier management, packaging→ Thermal Benchmarking → Thermal & Comfort Control Software → SOP development does e.g. not include: thermal management of powertrain components - such scope must be allocated to respective IC Based and Electrification Products

products.name: E/E Systems (incl Cyber Security & Safety)
products.description: HV and LV electric and electronics incl. software, functional safety, cyber security, infotainment, telematics, comfort electronics, wiring harness, EMC, data and network architecture, function architecture, wiring architecture and harness components, EE systems and related EE testing / EE simulation

products.name: ADAS / Automated Driving (incl. Connectivity)
products.description: Complete system, software, hardware, sensors (requirements engineering, system design, development, integration and validation) and connectivity

products.name: Spark Ignited
products.description: Spark Ignited engines (Gasoline, H2, e-Fuels, etc) incl. engines for Hybrid powertrains, including embedded software

products.name: Compression Ignited
products.description: Compression Ignited engines (Diesel, NH3, e-Fuels etc) incl. engines for Hybrid powertrains, including embedded software

products.name: Powertrain System Integration, incl. Hybrid Powertrains
products.description: Development of Hybrid-Electric and Conventional Powertrains covering System Design (i.e. Requirement Engineering and System Specification), System Integration (i.e. functional, electrical and mechanical integration of all powertrain components) and System Calibration (i.e. Calibration of central powertrain controller) as well as Powertrain System Verification & Validation on Integration Test Instances (PAVIL and in Vehicle)

products.name: Transmission incl. Hybrid Transmission
products.description: Transmission incl. Hybrid Transmissions (DHT, AMT, AT, DCT, CVT, …….)

products.name: BEV Transmission and EDU / E-Axles
products.description: Transmissions and E-axles / Electric Drive Units Note: Please assign E-Machine and Power Electronic development share to “EM”

products.name: Powertrain System Integration BEV
products.description: Development of High Voltage Powertrains for Fuel Cell and Battery electric powertrains covering System Design (i.e. Requirement Engineering and System Specification), System Integration (i.e. functional, electrical and mechanical integration of all powertrain and all High Voltage components) and System Calibration (i.e. Calibration of central powertrain controller) as well as HV Powertrain System Verification & Validation on Integration Test Instances (HV Integration Test Bed, PAVIL and in Vehicle)

products.name: E-machine & Power Electronics
products.description: E-Machine & Power Electronics (incl. On Board Chargers) incl. their integration

products.name: Fuel Cell
products.description: PEM and Solid Oxide Fuel Cell - including embedded software

products.name: Electrolyzer
products.description: PEM, SOEC, AEL, AEM Electrolyzers, e-fuel and hydrogen derivates - including embedded software

products.name: Emerging Energy Technologies
products.description: Carbon Capture, Low Carbon Hydrogen, Stationary Energy Storage, Smart Grid Integration, Solar Water Splitting, non-Hydrogen Energy Technologies - including embedded software

products.name: Others (Testing facility Rentals, Manufacturing, etc)
products.description: Testing facility Rentals, Manufacturing, certification and homologation @ MTC, test equipment @ Tippelmann

skills.name: Simulation

skills.name: Design

skills.name: Software & Controls, E/E

skills.name: Verification, Validation, Reliability & Industrialization (ickl. BIC)
